notes_for_editor: Only the register record and general Alberta sources were found. Two web searches and a fallback search for Alberta Deer Mountain returned nothing about this tower; results for Deer Mountain lookouts in Montana and New Hampshire were not used. No source describes this tower's history. Reading access mode 'drive' as reached by road follows the Adair record and is not defined in any source. The brief's access value 'closed' is not supported and is corrected to restricted. Fact-check 2026-10-20: the access mode 'drive' is not defined in any source, so the story no longer glosses it as road access.
